method.aggregation: Mean paired steered-minus-unsteered difference over questions within each persona, then equal mean across personas. Configurations are kept separate.

bootstrap.unit: question ID shared across all personas
bootstrap.interval: 95% percentile interval; resample 12 question IDs with replacement and retain all eight persona pairs for each sampled question

method.scope: Descriptive association for the selected eight personas and twelve questions, not literal word occurrence. Persona-specific word banks differ; their scores receive equal weight.
method.specificity: Own-persona score minus the mean of seven rival personas in the same bank; paired difference of these margins.
method.limitations: Exploratory question-composition intervals for a small, deliberately selected set, not population-wide inference. Personas are fixed, not resampled. No multiple-comparison correction.
method.missing: Require a complete finite paired grid for every metric; fail rather than silently alter weights.
